summary: Isolated & Dual-Mode Thermal Receipt Printing Architecture: Clean receipt printing using dynamic hidden iframe isolation, direct Web Bluetooth ESC/POS engine, silent auto-reconnect via navigator.bluetooth.getDevices() (zero-prompt post-payment printing), Multi-Unit Parametric Paper Width Engine (mm, cm, in, px/dots, chars) with 100% backward compatibility, Epson LX-310 Continuous Form & Half-Size Sideways presets (9.5"x5.5", 5.5"/140mm Sideways, 4.75"/120mm NCR Split) with SaaS-Standard Left-Origin alignment, Windows GDI Anti-Centering (@page size: auto), 1-Line Compact Tabular layout & 9-pin Anti-Dither Pure Black mode, Adaptive Dual-Speed BLE Pacing (Fast Burst <=1.28KB & Motor-Matched Anti-Clip >1.28KB for 4KB buffer protection), Universal Normal Weight (Zero-Bold / Anti-Bleed) standard, WYSIWYG live preview alignment, Floyd-Steinberg monochrome logo dithering & ESC/POS GS v 0 raster encoding.
